title: The Adventure of TED  and the lost magic crystals
description:
The Adventures of TED and the Lost Magic CrystalsA cozy 2.5D platformer with a nostalgic retro feel.

A colorful world is waiting to be explored. Join TED on a lighthearted adventure through a charming kingdom, overcome fun platforming challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and recover the lost Magic Crystals.

Features• 31 Unique Levels – Explore a variety of colorful environments and platforming challenges.

• Cinematic Storytelling – Enjoy seamless story moments that keep you immersed in the adventure.

• Hidden Secrets – Discover hidden keys, treasure chests, and collectibles throughout the world.

• Epic Boss Battles – Face giant bosses with unique mechanics and exciting gameplay.

• Full Controller Support – Native support for Xbox and PlayStation controllers for a smooth experience.

Created by RgamesID, The Adventures of TED and the Lost Magic Crystals combines charming low-poly 3D visuals with the nostalgic spirit of classic 32-bit platformers, delivering a cozy adventure for players of all ages.
description_short: A cozy journey through a world of color. Join TED in this relaxing 2.5D platformer as he jumps, explores, and fights to save the Squirrel Kingdom. Solve relaxing puzzles and discover hidden treasures.
